# AROFi Market

AROFi Market is AROFi's multi-vendor marketplace for networking equipment and supporting technology.

Canonical URL: https://market.arofi.net/
Launch market: Uganda
Status: Coming soon — waitlist open

Planned categories include routers, access points, switches, CCTV, computers, phones, cables and fibre, power backup, networking tools and related accessories.

AROFi Market is designed around approved sellers, buyer protection, product verification and optional AROFi-ready configuration for eligible networking equipment.

Buyers and prospective sellers can join the launch waitlist at https://market.arofi.net/#waitlist.
